search_text: published ZDI-11-347 ZDI-CAN-1085 Microsoft Office Word Hidden Border Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-12-13 CVE-2011-1983 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-1983 9.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:P/A:P ['Microsoft'] ['Office Word'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Office Word 2007/2010. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within how the application handles a border containing a specific property. When parsing this property, the application will incorrectly free it. If the application attempts to render the object, a use-after-free condition can be made to occur. This can lead to code execution under the context of the application. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/security/bulletin/MS11-089 ['2011-04-01 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-12-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Nikita Tarakanov (CISS Research Team) and Alexey Sintsov (Digital Security Research Group) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-347/
title: Microsoft Office Word Hidden Border Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Office Word 2007/2010. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within how the application handles a border containing a specific property. When parsing this property, the application will incorrectly free it. If the application attempts to render the object, a use-after-free condition can be made to occur. This can lead to code execution under the context of the application.
